name: oapi-workspace
description: Build-time OpenAPI and JSON Schema generation from TypeScript contracts

scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run json:examples && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc --noEmit
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run example:build
scripts.build:packages: npm run build:ast && npm run build:openapi && npm run build:schema && npm run build:compiler && npm run build:express && npm run build:fetch && npm run build:tsgen && npm run build:vite
scripts.json: npm run build && npm run json:examples
scripts.examples:check: npm run build && npm run check --workspaces --if-present
scripts.prepack:packages: node --input-type=module -e "import { mkdirSync } from 'node:fs'; mkdirSync('.oapi/packages', { recursive: true })"
scripts.pack:packages: npm pack --workspace packages/ast --workspace packages/compiler --workspace packages/express --workspace packages/fetch --workspace packages/openapi --workspace packages/schema --workspace packages/tsgen --workspace packages/vite --ignore-scripts --pack-destination .oapi/packages
